dimension_grades.evidence: The draft jumps directly to the root cause with no description of any wrong theories or false leads pursued during the investigation.
The draft uses passive/collective framing ('the issue turned out to be') and never has the author take personal ownership of a mistake or oversight.
No time wasted on wrong paths is mentioned; the only time reference is 'several weeks' of memory growth, not time spent on dead-end investigations.
The tone is neutral and professional throughout, with no self-deprecating or wry humor about mistakes made.
The root cause is revealed in the second section ('Root Cause') immediately after 'The Problem,' with no depiction of initial misreadings or ambiguous evidence.
The 'Investigation Methodology' section lists steps in retrospective bullet points after the answer is already given, not as an unfolding discovery process.
The root cause is disclosed in the 'Root Cause' section before any investigation narrative, so there is no sustained tension preceding the reveal.
The draft contains no mention of the author's emotional state — no frustration, surprise, or relief — at any point during the investigation.
Takeaways like 'Always monitor your memory usage in production' and 'Be disciplined about removing listeners' are general principles, not specific behavior changes the author now follows.
The first takeaway is literally 'Always monitor your memory usage in production' — classic generic advice that is presented earnestly rather than acknowledged and moved past.
Takeaways are listed as abstract lessons without connecting them to specific moments or decisions in the narrative.
The conclusion says 'I hope this walkthrough helps you the next time you're facing a similar issue,' adopting a teacher-to-student framing rather than peer-to-peer.
The draft contains exactly two focused code snippets — the buggy version and the fixed version — which is appropriately minimal.
The critical bug line is marked with an inline comment: '// Bug: handler is never removed when this path executes'.
Both the problematic code and the fixed code are shown in separate labeled snippets, clearly illustrating the transformation.

Before the first snippet, the prose explains 'Each incoming request registered a listener... but under a specific error-handling path, the listener was never removed,' directing the reader's attention.
No concrete sensory or environmental details appear — no time of day, no description of a dashboard view, no Slack message or alert text.
The draft names specific tools: Prometheus, Chrome DevTools, Node.js 18, and Express.
The entire investigation is presented as a retrospective bulleted list ('Here's the systematic approach we followed') rather than dramatized scenes with action.
